scenarios.title: Native edition/catalog acquisition
scenarios.expect: Real server lists paginated ebooks/comics separately from recordings; granted exact-version bytes open in native readers; revoked/foreign content denied.
scenarios.evidence: Real-server native/emulator UI steps; byte hashes and HTTP assertions.

scenarios.title: Native reflowable reader
scenarios.expect: Preserved reader opens supported EPUB/KEPUB/FB2/MOBI/AZW3 fixtures, navigates and restores exact file/version; unsupported variants explicit.
scenarios.evidence: Actual Android reader events and emulator assertions; file/provenance inventory.

scenarios.title: Native PDF and comic reader
scenarios.expect: PDF coordinates/page/crop/rotation and comic index/entry identities are correct; CBZ/CBR/CB7 capability is truthful.
scenarios.evidence: Actual PDF/comic UI, renderer outputs, page/entry fixtures.

scenarios.title: Web/native actual locator compatibility
scenarios.expect: Actual produced locators round trip in both directions for supported same-file profiles after reflow; incompatible profiles/bytes never relabeled or resumed by percentage.
scenarios.evidence: Paired renderer trace/fixtures, selection or page identity assertions; coordinator decision for any new semantic boundary.

scenarios.title: Native annotations, shelves and completion
scenarios.expect: Supported private typed annotations/bookmarks/notes and ordinary shelf access use real APIs; manual completion affects only the edition/history; conflicts/tombstones retained.
scenarios.evidence: Native UI and persisted state, concurrent/stale writes and deletion replay.

scenarios.title: Native durable queues and downloads
scenarios.expect: Force-stop/relaunch/lost response preserve operation/base/version; account switch never exposes/sends another owner's content; revoked access locks; old downloads retain version.
scenarios.evidence: Both-flavor emulator tests, restarted process, database/queue assertions with synthetic accounts.

scenarios.title: Integrated native/web audio regression
scenarios.expect: Real decode, backward seek, cross-file chapters, natural-end/manual completion and explicit resume conflicts survive native/web handoff; proxy retains credentials.
scenarios.evidence: Both native flavors plus browser/API assertions against merged server.

scenarios.title: Sessions, refresh and grant revocation
scenarios.expect: Lost refresh response/serialized retries, disable/revoke, cookie CSRF and native media expiry work; account switch ignores late responses.
scenarios.evidence: Real API/browser/native concurrency, no token in receiver/reader data.

scenarios.title: Ingestion to edition/recording workflows
scenarios.expect: Scan/move/replacement preserves IDs as selected, produces editions/recordings and truthful capability; changed-byte old state 412; no duplicate ebook model.
scenarios.evidence: Real scan/probe, source hashes, native/web read and play.

scenarios.title: Recording repair with old clients/offline state
scenarios.expect: Merge/split yields successors/tombstones; old native snapshot and pending writes show explicit choices without losing canonical/history/candidates.
scenarios.evidence: Real repair API/UI then native online/offline retries and DB assertions.

scenarios.title: Per-format in-file writer fidelity
scenarios.expect: EPUB/MP3/FLAC/M4A/M4B field/variant writers enabled only with unchanged payload/chapter/artwork/unknown-tag evidence; unsafe variant disabled.
scenarios.evidence: Per-format round trips, decoded/element payload comparison, artwork hashes, malformed/stale plan failures.

scenarios.title: Reviewed write/import safety
scenarios.expect: Review and recheck, backup defaults/failure and staged recovery work; concurrent imports cannot overwrite; originals unchanged unless explicitly approved.
scenarios.evidence: Actual process-death stage runs; two publishers/workers; before/after bytes and journal.

scenarios.title: Opt-in provider qualification
scenarios.expect: Configured accepted providers fill gaps only; protected edits/clears survive; live synthetic/public query evidence and current terms recorded or clear blocker.
scenarios.evidence: Pinned adapter tests plus identified live/public query results and primary references; no replacement provider.

scenarios.title: Reconciliation and concurrent workers
scenarios.expect: Stability/two healthy absence scans and root identity work; unavailable roots preserve history; two servers serialize safely; hints cannot replace polling.
scenarios.evidence: Disposable local roots and multi-process/db assertions, healthy/unhealthy scan evidence.

scenarios.title: Actual TLS and separate reader origin
scenarios.expect: Certificate validation, secure cookies, real proxy headers and reader origin isolation hold in packaged stack; hostile books/bridges cannot reach privileged routes.
scenarios.evidence: Actual local TLS proxy/browser/native with valid and invalid certs; CORS/CSP/CSRF/network trace.

scenarios.title: Process-death job/state recovery
scenarios.expect: Kill server after partial extraction/import and durable SMTP boundary; restart preserves state and recovers coherently without uncertain resend.
scenarios.evidence: Owned process IDs, observed stage, sink counts and durable record checks before/after; no hook-only pass.

scenarios.title: SMTP key loss through real restart
scenarios.expect: Missing/wrong key at startup fails closed without loss; restoring original key recovers config and safe delivery on local sink.
scenarios.evidence: Separate processes/environments, encrypted DB inspection and synthetic log redaction; no real recipients.

scenarios.title: Credential log regression
scenarios.expect: Synthetic app passwords, KOReader keys, native tokens and SMTP secrets absent from actual server/proxy/error logs.
scenarios.evidence: Automated positive control plus non-disclosure assertions; redacted report only.

scenarios.title: OPDS semantic/conformance closure
scenarios.expect: Both feeds project granted data; Atom/XML semantics and identified authoritative validation rules checked; formal limits explicit; JSON schema checks pinned.
scenarios.evidence: Real endpoint responses and parser/validator outputs, licenses/checksums; no unavailable-schema full-conformance claim.

scenarios.title: Independent whole-stack restore rehearsal
scenarios.expect: Fresh restored stack preserves IDs/versions/grants/progress/annotations/shelves/conflicts/receipts and SMTP safety with keys; media unchanged.
scenarios.evidence: Backup manifest without secrets, restore commands, before/after invariant/workflow assertions; production policy unchosen.

scenarios.title: Unsigned package and provenance
scenarios.expect: Local package contains actual web/reader/media tools/notices; host FFmpeg absent; full/F-Droid dependency separation; build hashes/differences documented.
scenarios.evidence: Clean local artifact builds and inventory, source/license references and checksums; no signing/upload/tag/CI.

scenarios.title: Realistic per-capability corpus
scenarios.expect: Read/probe/seek/resume/annotate/download/write outcomes named per format/codec/client; RAR variants/fonts/PDF/audio corpus lawful; valid >4 GiB separate from sparse arithmetic.
scenarios.evidence: Fixture origin/license/hash/size and device/browser version; outputs and explicit incomplete states.

scenarios.title: Mounted NAS acceptance
scenarios.expect: Dedicated mounted SMB/NFS test roots recover disconnect, rename, partial copy and publication safely without destructive absences; unsupported writes fail closed.
scenarios.evidence: Named host/protocol/filesystem/mount/options; coordinated disconnect/reconnect and race traces, no private share mutation.

scenarios.title: Actual KOReader/OPDS app over TLS
scenarios.expect: Full app authenticates, searches/pages/downloads exact originals; two device credentials retain stale conflicts and web resolution; restart preserves baselines/candidates.
scenarios.evidence: Pinned actual app/device/UI and TLS evidence; no UI stand-ins counted; generic 409 warning disclosed.

scenarios.title: Upstream large-file digest agreement
scenarios.expect: Upstream algorithm and server agree on sparse >1 GiB vectors and available valid large content; identity ambiguity/replacement refuse guessing.
scenarios.evidence: Upstream version/source hashes, sparse versus valid-file labels and independent digest outputs.

scenarios.title: Screen-reader, keyboard and touch
scenarios.expect: Manual screen reader can operate app plus actual reader/annotations/conflicts; focus/labels/contrast/touch reflow reviewed; automated iframe gap not called pass.
scenarios.evidence: Named reader/OS/browser/device/version and task results; automated axe supplementary.

scenarios.title: Both Android emulator flavors
scenarios.expect: Full/F-Droid real UI/native reader/audio/account/recovery instrumentation and lint/unit/assembly pass against integrated server.
scenarios.evidence: Owned emulator identity, OS/ABI/WebView, commands/counts/skips; prior emulator untouched.

scenarios.title: Physical Android acceptance
scenarios.expect: Phone decoder/background/offline, TalkBack/media and device lifecycle verified on actual phone; emulator cannot close.
scenarios.evidence: Actual hardware/operator/version required; currently unconfirmed resource.

scenarios.title: Physical Android Auto acceptance
scenarios.expect: Real head unit browse/search/artwork/voice/steering-wheel/resume succeeds with safe user-operated setup.
scenarios.evidence: Named actual head unit/phone/versions/operator; emulator/DHU evidence remains separate.

scenarios.title: Delayed actual Chromecast debugging
scenarios.expect: Actual receiver handoff/seek/reconnect/expiry/revocation through preserved phone proxy works; no server token goes to receiver.
scenarios.evidence: User-coordinated final phase; named receiver/controller/firmware/network and redacted traces. Pending until run.
scenarios.blocker: User requested Chromecast debugging last; actual receiver/controller not identified.

scenarios.title: Separate migration release hold
scenarios.expect: T008 remains separately unassigned until design/decisions; no T007 importer or false migration/release pass.
scenarios.evidence: Release-gate report referencing ADR-0063 open source/mapping/conversion questions.
scenarios.blocker: Separate package or explicit user decision required.

scenarios.title: Production decisions and release hold
scenarios.expect: Unchosen support/migration execution/backup/signing/distribution policies identified; Actions disabled and no release/publish authorized.
scenarios.evidence: Coordinator-facing decision list and changed-path audit; any remote hold check is read-only, not reactivation.
scenarios.blocker: Separate package or explicit user decision required.
